name: Figure 02
summary: The second-generation humanoid from Figure AI, shown in August 2024 with onboard vision-language reasoning, six cameras and 16-DOF hands. Figure ran it on a BMW assembly line in Spartanburg, then in early 2025 dropped its OpenAI-based speech partnership in favour of an in-house vision-language-action model, Helix, and announced a higher-volume successor, Figure 03.
notable: Early factory pilot on a BMW production line
Transitioned to an in-house VLA model (Helix, 2025)
